cues.en: Look at this beautiful framework.
cues.zh: 看看這個漂亮的框架。

cues.en: Now, we've covered each of these steps briefly.
cues.zh: 已經簡單介紹各個步驟。

cues.en: We're going to we're going to dive into to each of them one by one.
cues.zh: 接著逐一深入。

cues.en: The first one is problem definition.
cues.zh: 第一步是定義問題。

cues.en: The question you're trying to answer in the first step is what problem are we trying to solve?
cues.zh: 要回答的是，我們想解決什麼問題？

cues.en: But before we get into different types of machine learning problems, it's important to note machine learning isn't the solution to every problem.
cues.zh: 介紹不同機器學習問題前，要先知道，機器學習不是所有問題的解答。

cues.en: You might think that's weird being in a machine learning course, but this is this is an important concept to remember.
cues.zh: 在機器學習課聽到這句也許覺得奇怪，但這概念很重要。

cues.en: So when shouldn't you use machine learning?
cues.zh: 什麼時候不該用機器學習？

cues.en: Well, will a simple hand coded instruction based system work?
cues.zh: 如果簡單、手寫指令的系統就能完成，

cues.en: Then you should favor the simpler system over the machine learning system.
cues.zh: 就應該優先使用簡單系統。

cues.en: Such as if you wanted to make the favourite chicken dish we used before an example, if you had the ingredients and you knew the exact steps you had to take to create your favorite chicken dish, it's
cues.zh: 例如先前最愛的雞肉料理，如果有食材，也知道確切步驟，

cues.en: probably best that you choose a simple system over using machine learning to try and figure the steps out.
cues.zh: 最好選擇簡單系統，不要用機器學習重新找步驟。

cues.en: Other than these kind of scenarios where, you know, the simple hand coded instruction base system already, most of the time, you can probably find value using machine learning.
cues.zh: 除了已經知道如何用簡單指令完成的這類情況，其他時候，多半能從機器學習找到價值。

cues.en: Now comes the first step in identifying the problem we're trying to solve as a machine learning problem.
cues.zh: 現在先辨識，眼前的問題屬於哪種機器學習問題。

cues.en: We can do this by matching our problem.
cues.zh: 把我們的問題，

cues.en: The one we're working on.
cues.zh: 也就是正在處理的，

cues.en: It might be a business problem or some other kind of problem to the main types of machine learning problem.
cues.zh: 商業或其他問題，對應到主要的機器學習問題類型。

cues.en: These are supervised learning, unsupervised learning, transfer learning and reinforcement learning.
cues.zh: 包括監督式、非監督式、遷移學習，以及強化學習。

cues.en: We're going to be focused on supervised learning, unsupervised learning and transfer learning.
cues.zh: 我們聚焦監督式、非監督式與遷移學習。

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because these are the most common ones you'll find and you'll come across in practice.
cues.zh: 因為實務中最常遇到這些。

cues.en: And then the ones when I was machine learning engineer, when I work on machine learning problems that have proven time and time again to be useful.
cues.zh: 我擔任機器學習工程師、處理相關問題時，這些方法也反覆證明很實用。

cues.en: Supervised learning is called supervised learning because you have data and labels.
cues.zh: 監督式學習之所以叫監督式，是因為有資料和標籤。

cues.en: A machine learning algorithm tries to use the data to predict a label.
cues.zh: 演算法試著根據資料預測標籤。

cues.en: If it guesses the label wrong, the algorithm corrects itself and tries again.
cues.zh: 猜錯時，就修正自己，再試一次。

cues.en: This act of correction is why it's called supervised.
cues.zh: 這種修正過程，就是稱為監督式的原因。

cues.en: It's like if you were trying to guess the steps it took to turn a set of ingredients, the data into your favorite chicken dish, the label.
cues.zh: 像試著找出，如何把食材這份資料，變成最愛的雞肉料理這個標籤。

cues.en: If you tried once and got it wrong, you tell yourself this was wrong.
cues.zh: 試一次做錯了，就告訴自己這次不對。

cues.en: Maybe next time we'll try something different.
cues.zh: 下次換個做法。

cues.en: A supervised learning algorithm repeats this process over and over and over again, trying to get better.
cues.zh: 監督式演算法不斷重複這個過程，努力改善。

cues.en: The main types of supervised learning problems are classification and regression.
cues.zh: 主要的監督式問題是分類和迴歸。

cues.en: Classification involves predicting if something is one thing or another, such as if you want it to
cues.zh: 分類要預測某件事物屬於哪一類，例如，

cues.en: predict whether or not a patient had heart disease or not based on their medical records or what type of dog breed was in an image.
cues.zh: 根據病歷判斷患者是否有心臟病，或影像中是哪種狗。

cues.en: If there are only two options, it's called binary classification.
cues.zh: 如果只有兩個選項，稱為二元分類。

cues.en: If there are more than two options, it's called multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 超過兩個選項，稱為多類別分類。

cues.en: So trying to predict heart disease or not heart disease would be binary classification because there's only two classes.
cues.zh: 預測有沒有心臟病，是二元分類，因為只有兩類。

cues.en: Heart disease or not, heart disease.
cues.zh: 有心臟病，或沒有心臟病。

cues.en: And trying to predict different dog breeds based on photos in in images would be multiclass classification because there are many different kinds of dog breeds.
cues.zh: 依照片預測狗的品種，則是多類別分類，因為狗有很多品種。

cues.en: Regression problems involve trying to predict a number.
cues.zh: 迴歸問題是預測數字。

cues.en: You might hear it referred to as a continuous number as well, which just means a number which can go up or down.
cues.zh: 也可能聽到連續數值，意思是數字可以上升或下降。

cues.en: A classical regression problem is trying to predict the sale price of a house based on things like number of rooms, the area it's in, how many bathrooms it has, or trying to predict how many people will
cues.zh: 典型例子，是根據房間數、地區、浴室數等，預測房屋售價；或根據網站瀏覽與點擊，預測多少人會，

cues.en: buy a new app based on website visits and clicks.
cues.zh: 購買新的 App。

cues.en: Unsupervised learning has data but no labels.
cues.zh: 非監督式學習有資料，但沒有標籤。

cues.en: For example, you might have the purchase history of all customers at your store, and your marketing team wants to send out a promotion for next summer, but they know not everyone will be interested in
cues.zh: 例如有商店所有客戶的購買紀錄，行銷團隊想發送明年夏季促銷，但知道不是每個人都對，

cues.en: new summer clothes.
cues.zh: 新夏裝有興趣。

cues.en: So they come to you as the in-house data science and machine learning engineer and ask, Do you know who's interested in summer clothes?
cues.zh: 所以來問公司內部的資料科學與機器學習工程師，也就是你，誰會有興趣？

cues.en: Well, the thing is, you don't either.
cues.zh: 其實你也不知道。

cues.en: But, you know, you can figure it out from the data you have.
cues.zh: 但知道能從現有資料找出來。

cues.en: So you decide to run an algorithm to find patterns in the data and group customers who purchase similar things together.
cues.zh: 因此執行演算法，找出資料模式，把購買類似商品的客戶分成群組。

cues.en: Once it's finished, you notice two groups.
cues.zh: 完成後，發現兩群。

cues.en: One group of customers who purchase only during winter time, and one group of customers who purchase mostly during summer time.
cues.zh: 一群只在冬天購物，另一群大多夏天購物。

cues.en: You label them with winter customers and some are customers and send them to your marketing team and they thank you for saving them, sending out thousands of unwanted emails.
cues.zh: 你標示為冬季客戶與夏季客戶，交給行銷團隊；他們感謝你避免發送數千封不受歡迎的郵件。

cues.en: I'm sure you've probably got some of those kind of emails in your email inbox before.
cues.zh: 你的信箱大概也收過這種郵件。

cues.en: What's important to note here is that you provided the labels.
cues.zh: 重點是，標籤由你提供。

cues.en: They weren't there to begin with, but the patterns were.
cues.zh: 一開始沒有標籤，但有模式。

cues.en: And that's what the machine learning algorithm found.
cues.zh: 演算法找到的，就是模式。

cues.en: And after inspecting the groups, you're the one who saw the commonalities and applied the labels such as summer or winter.
cues.zh: 檢查群組後，你看出共同點，再套用夏季或冬季等標籤。

cues.en: Problems like this are also called clustering or putting groups of similar examples together.
cues.zh: 這類問題也稱分群，把相似範例分在一起。

cues.en: Recommendation problems such as recommending what music someone should listen to based on their previous music choices, often start out as unsupervised learning problems like this.
cues.zh: 推薦問題，例如依過去音樂選擇推薦歌曲，常從這種非監督式問題開始。

cues.en: Transfer learning leverages what one machine learning model has learned in another machine learning.
cues.zh: 遷移學習，把一個機器學習模型所學，運用到另一個模型。

cues.en: For example, say you're trying to predict what dog breed appears in a photo.
cues.zh: 例如想預測照片裡的狗是哪個品種。

cues.en: That's a cute dog.
cues.zh: 這隻狗很可愛。

cues.en: That's my that's my puppy.
cues.zh: 這是我的小狗。

cues.en: Seven.
cues.zh: 叫 Seven。

cues.en: And that's Bella in the background there.
cues.zh: 後面那隻是 Bella。

cues.en: She's posing.
cues.zh: 她在擺姿勢。

cues.en: She knows she's she knows she's on this lecture.
cues.zh: 她知道自己出現在這堂課。

cues.en: You could find an existing model which is learned to decipher different car types and fine tune it for your task.
cues.zh: 可以找到已學會辨識汽車種類的模型，再為你的任務微調。

cues.en: Now, why is this valuable?
cues.zh: 這為什麼有價值？

cues.en: Because training a machine learning algorithm, which means letting it find all of the patterns in data, can be a very expensive task to find patterns in data.
cues.zh: 因為訓練演算法、讓它找出所有資料模式，可能非常昂貴。

cues.en: A machine learning algorithm has to make millions of calculations.
cues.zh: 需要做數百萬次計算。

cues.en: And although computers are very fast at making calculations, making calculations aren't free.
cues.zh: 雖然電腦算得很快，但運算不是免費。

cues.en: So instead of learning everything about different photos from scratch, such as what patterns different
cues.zh: 不用從零學習照片裡的一切，例如不同，

cues.en: trees look like, what different shapes are like, the rectangle down here, what grass looks like, the car type model, the machine learning model which is figured out what kind of different cars look
cues.zh: 樹木的模式、不同形狀，像下面的矩形，以及草的模樣；辨識汽車種類的模型，

cues.en: like, has already done most of these things.
cues.zh: 已經完成大部分工作。

cues.en: If you've already trained a model, it might have already figured out, okay, these are trees, not cars, these are grass.
cues.zh: 訓練過的模型也許已經知道，這些是樹，不是車，這些是草。

cues.en: And so it kind of has an idea of what different patterns look like.
cues.zh: 所以大致了解不同模式的樣子。

cues.en: Now you can think of this as being the same as when you write an essay versus writing poetry.
cues.zh: 可以想成寫文章和寫詩。

cues.en: Although the writing styles are different, the writing that you do uses the same fundamental principles.
cues.zh: 雖然文體不同，但都使用相同的寫作基本原則。

cues.en: So we can take this car model that identifies different cars and use its foundational patterns and apply it to our dog breed problem.
cues.zh: 因此能運用汽車辨識模型學到的基礎模式，處理狗品種問題。

cues.en: Of course, there's a few more steps involved here, but that's the basic premise of transfer learning.
cues.zh: 當然還有其他步驟，但這是遷移學習的基本概念。

cues.en: Reinforcement learning involves having a computer program perform some actions within a defined space and rewarding it for doing it well or punishing it for doing poorly.
cues.zh: 強化學習讓程式在定義好的環境採取行動，做得好就獎勵，做不好就懲罰。

cues.en: A good example is teaching a machine learning algorithm to play chess.
cues.zh: 例如教機器學習演算法下西洋棋。

cues.en: The chess board is the divine space and the actions are moving pieces.
cues.zh: 棋盤是定義好的環境，行動是移動棋子。

cues.en: And when I say punishment or reward, these things could be as simple as updating a score with plus one if it wins and negative one if it loses.
cues.zh: 獎勵與懲罰可以很簡單，贏加 1 分，輸扣 1 分。

cues.en: The machine learning algorithms goal could be to maximize the score.
cues.zh: 演算法的目標可以是把分數最大化。

cues.en: So this means if you've done it right, it should learn moves which lead to wins.
cues.zh: 如果設定正確，就應該學會容易獲勝的走法。

cues.en: Reinforcement learning is what was used for Deepmind's AlphaGo to become the best go a complicated Chinese
cues.zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaGo 就用強化學習，成為頂尖圍棋棋手；圍棋是源自中國、

cues.en: ball game, far more complicated than chess player of all time, defeating many go world champions.
cues.zh: 比西洋棋複雜得多的棋類，它擊敗了多位圍棋世界冠軍。

cues.en: And although promising reinforcement learning has yet to find its way into to many practical applications,
cues.zh: 雖然前景看好，講者認為強化學習當時還沒有很多實際應用。

cues.en: and since we're focused on building practical solutions, we've decided to focus on the other kinds of learning, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and transfer learning throughout
cues.zh: 因為聚焦實用解決方案，所以課程選擇其他學習方式，例如監督式、非監督式與遷移，

cues.en: this course.
cues.zh: 學習。

cues.en: Now, you know the major types of learning.
cues.zh: 現在知道主要學習類型。

cues.en: You've now got the tools to tackle step one in the framework problem definition, aligning the problem you're trying to solve to a machine learning problem.
cues.zh: 也有工具完成框架第一步：定義問題，把想解決的問題對應到機器學習類型。

cues.en: So for supervised learning, you might say, I know my inputs and outputs such as I've got patient records could be the inputs.
cues.zh: 監督式學習可以說，我知道輸入與輸出，例如輸入是病歷。

cues.en: And the outputs are whether or not the patient has heart disease or your inputs could be the parameters
cues.zh: 輸出是患者有沒有心臟病；輸入也可以是不同房屋，

cues.en: of a different house and the number of rooms where it's located, how many bathrooms there are, and your outputs are, how much the house costs.
cues.zh: 的參數，例如房間數、位置、浴室數，輸出則是房價。

cues.en: So that's a regression problem.
cues.zh: 這就是迴歸。

cues.en: And for unsupervised learning, you might say, I'm not sure of the outputs, but I do have inputs such as customer purchases, and you're trying to figure out which customers are most similar to each other.
cues.zh: 非監督式可以說，我不知道輸出，但有客戶購物等輸入，想找出哪些客戶最相似。

cues.en: Or for transfer learning.
cues.zh: 遷移學習則，

cues.en: You may think my problem might be similar to something else.
cues.zh: 可以想，我的問題也許和另一個相似。

cues.en: Can I leverage what an existing machine learning model has learned and use it in my own?
cues.zh: 能不能把現有模型學到的東西，運用到自己的模型？

cues.en: Now, don't worry if these kinds of learning are sort of going over your head at the moment, we're going to be building a hands on project for each of these learning times supervised, unsupervised and
cues.zh: 現在聽不懂這些類型，不用擔心；整門課會實作每種類型的專案，包含監督式、非監督式與，

cues.en: transfer throughout the course.
cues.zh: 遷移學習。

cues.en: In the meantime, have to think about some of the problems you face day to day.
cues.zh: 先想想日常遇到的一些問題。

cues.en: Could any of them be classified as a machine learning problem?
cues.zh: 能不能歸類成機器學習問題？

cues.en: Are you trying to classify whether one thing is something or another that's a classification problem?
cues.zh: 是不是在判斷事物屬於哪一類？那就是分類。

cues.en: Do you ever try to predict what a what a number might be?
cues.zh: 是否曾經試著預測某個數字？

cues.en: That could be a regression problem.
cues.zh: 那可能是迴歸。
